long_biography.plain_text:
Following İbrahim Hayri Barut's death in 1961, Belma Barut safeguarded the drugmaker until her children were ready to lead it. Daughter Nesrin later shared a 50-percent holding with husband Ahmet Kamil Esirtgen. In 1981 she entered leadership alongside sibling Nezih, concentrating on overseas relationships and collaborations.

Today Esirtgen serves as vice chair, a governance position supported by her continuing family stake. Her cultural work includes creating the Nesrin Esirtgen Collection, an exhibition venue that promoted contemporary artists and sponsored an İnci Eviner monograph. As founding trustee-chair of the family's charitable foundation, she oversees education, sport and health initiatives, including free accommodation for young cancer patients' families.
long_biography.html:
Following İbrahim Hayri Barut's death in 1961, Belma Barut safeguarded the drugmaker until her children were ready to lead it. Daughter Nesrin later shared a 50-percent holding with husband Ahmet Kamil Esirtgen. In 1981 she entered leadership alongside sibling Nezih, concentrating on overseas relationships and collaborations.

Today Esirtgen serves as vice chair, a governance position supported by her continuing family stake. Her cultural work includes creating the Nesrin Esirtgen Collection, an exhibition venue that promoted contemporary artists and sponsored an İnci Eviner monograph. As founding trustee-chair of the family's charitable foundation, she oversees education, sport and health initiatives, including free accommodation for young cancer patients' families.
